paragraphs.text: Douala International Airport (DLA/FKKD) serves as a key air gateway for Douala, CM, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 12/30: 2850 m (9350 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Douala International Airport with central Douala include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from DLA should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Douala International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Douala International Airport is DLA and the ICAO code is FKKD.

faqs.q: Which city does DLA airport serve?
faqs.a: Douala International Airport (DLA) serves Douala, CM.
